install_notes.detail: python3 on PATH is 3.9.6, below the 3.10 requirement. Homebrew Python 3.13.7 is installed and is the interpreter FIXR uses.
pipx 1.7.1. It does not have cambot-cli installed.
esptool.py 4.12.0 is inside the ESP-IDF Python 3.9 environment at ~/.espressif. It is not on the default PATH. PlatformIO Core 6.1.18 is also installed.

ESP-IDF v5.5.6 is at ~/esp/esp-idf. The plan says ESP-IDF 5.x and does not pin a release, so this is the current 5.x bugfix. install.sh selected Python 3.9.6 because that is python3 on PATH. cmake 4.4.5 and ninja 1.13.2 were missing and were installed with Homebrew. firmware/ built cambot_bringup.bin for esp32s3, 16 MB flash, octal PSRAM.
The cambot CLI is not installed. It ships with firmware milestone M2, which is not in this repository. Do not invent cambot commands.
TTL port looked like /dev/cu.usbserial-XXXX. esptool identified ESP32-S3 with embedded 8 MB PSRAM. Port name changes on replug.
Flashed the bring-up image at 115200 on the TTL port. Boot log: boot=HELLO cambot fw=setup, flash_mb=16, psram_mb=8, camera=ok pid=0x3660. Use 115200; 460800 drops on this board's CH340.
Joined the user's 2.4 GHz network as WPA3-SAE. Early wifi=disconnected reason=2 / reason=204 can appear once before wifi=ip=...; that is not a failure if register=ok follows.
POST /api/register returned register=ok. The registrar listed the camera and fetched GET /api/v1/frame.jpg. Detect the host LAN address at setup time; do not reuse a stale profile IP.
fixr/registrar/serve.py --check registered a local client, listed it, and served the page. Frame fetch returns 503 until CAMBOT_CAMERA_PASSWORD is set.
